rejected_near_neighbors.reason: Too broad to distinguish package, fixity, format, dependency, replica, rights, privacy, and authority mechanisms.
Split into package manifests, fixity events, scrub schedules, replica topology, and algorithm-status controls.
Split into identification conflict, risk review, migration lineage, loss typing, and publication hold.
Split into fault domains, storage media, sync state, independence signals, scrub evidence, and deletion holds.
Split into PREMIS event records, PROV crosswalks, timestamps, rights, personal-data minimization, and agent placeholders.
Split into source-object graphs, dependencies, build-environment hashes, generated artifacts, and an explicit reproducibility hold.
Limited to structural status and handover surfaces while manual and affected-user evaluation remains reserved.
Replaced by explicit ownership, custody, access, retention, deletion, disclosure, return, remedy, affected-community, and Māori-authority reservations.
Narrowed to synthetic VC, CWT, and PROV profiles with absent keys, trust, status, authority, and interoperability.
Requires repository access, event data, operational context, authority, and independent review; narrowed to zero-row readiness.
